title.en: Unit 3: Choosing a Spouse and Emphasis

intro.en: A reading passage about marriage in Islam and how to choose a spouse. Read it slowly, sentence by sentence, then learn the new words.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum shaadi aur biwi ke intikhaab ke baare mein ek parhne ka matn parhenge. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein, phir naye alfaaz seekhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنِ الزَّواجِ في الإِسْلامِ وَكَيْفِيَّةِ اخْتِيارِ الزَّوْجَةِ. اقْرَأْهُ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً بِبُطْءٍ، ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ الكَلِماتِ الجَديدَةَ.

dialogue.ar: اِخْتِيارُ الزَّوْجَةِ أَهَمُّ مَرْحَلَةٍ قَبْلَ الدُّخولِ في الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: ikhtiyāru z-zawjati ahammu marḥalatin qabla d-dukhūli fī l-ḥayāti z-zawjiyya
dialogue.en: Choosing a wife is the most important stage before entering married life.
dialogue.ur: Biwi ka intikhaab shaadi-shuda zindagi mein dakhil hone se pehle sab se aham marhala hai.

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ الزَّواجَ رابِطَةٌ وَثيقَةٌ وَعَلاقَةٌ إِنْسانِيَّةٌ.
dialogue.tr: li-anna z-zawāja rābiṭatun wathīqatun wa ʿalāqatun insāniyya
dialogue.en: Because marriage is a strong bond and a human relationship.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke nikaah ek mazboot rishta aur insani ta'alluq hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالزَّواجُ أَمْرٌ ضَرورِيٌّ لِاسْتِمْرارِ الحَياةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa z-zawāju amrun ḍarūriyyun li-stimrāri l-ḥayāt
dialogue.en: Marriage is necessary for life to continue.
dialogue.ur: Nikaah zindagi ke jaari rehne ke liye zaroori hai.

dialogue.ar: يَشْعُرُ الرَّجُلُ بِالحاجَةِ إِلى المَرْأَةِ، وَتَشْعُرُ المَرْأَةُ بِالحاجَةِ إِلى الرَّجُلِ.
dialogue.tr: yashʿuru r-rajulu bi-l-ḥājati ilā l-mar'a, wa tashʿuru l-mar'atu bi-l-ḥājati ilā r-rajul
dialogue.en: The man feels the need for the woman, and the woman feels the need for the man.
dialogue.ur: Mard ko aurat ki zaroorat mehsoos hoti hai aur aurat ko mard ki.

dialogue.ar: الإِسْلامُ يَسْمو بِالزَّواجِ عَنِ الحَيَوانِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: al-islāmu yasmū bi-z-zawāji ʿani l-ḥayawāniyya
dialogue.en: Islam raises marriage above animal-like behaviour.
dialogue.ur: Islam nikaah ko haiwaani sifaat se buland karta hai.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَمِنْ آياتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِنْ أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَزْواجاً لِتَسْكُنوا إِلَيْها وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً﴾
dialogue.tr: wa min āyātihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwājan li-taskunū ilayhā wa jaʿala baynakum mawaddatan wa raḥma
dialogue.en: «And among His signs is that He created for you spouses from yourselves so that you may find rest in them, and He placed between you affection and mercy.» (Quran)
dialogue.ur: «Aur uski nishaniyon mein se hai ke usne tumhare liye tumhi mein se jode banaye taake tum unse sukoon pao, aur tumhare darmiyan mohabbat aur rahmat rakhi.» (Quran)

dialogue.ar: وَعَمَلِيَّةُ الاخْتِيارِ تَحْتاجُ إِلى جُهْدٍ لِلْعُثورِ عَلى الشَّريكِ المُناسِبِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿamaliyyatu l-ikhtiyāri taḥtāju ilā juhdin lil-ʿuthūri ʿalā sh-sharīki l-munāsib
dialogue.en: Choosing takes effort in order to find the suitable partner.
dialogue.ur: Intikhaab ke amal mein munasib saathi talaash karne ke liye koshish chahiye.

dialogue.ar: أَهَمُّ صِفَةٍ لِلزَّوْجَةِ أَنْ تَكونَ ذاتَ دينٍ.
dialogue.tr: ahammu ṣifatin liz-zawjati an takūna dhāta dīn
dialogue.en: The most important quality in a wife is that she is religious.
dialogue.ur: Biwi ki sab se aham sifat yeh hai ke woh deendar ho.

dialogue.ar: ﴿فَالصّالِحاتُ قانِتاتٌ حافِظاتٌ لِلْغَيْبِ بِما حَفِظَ اللهُ﴾
dialogue.tr: fa-ṣ-ṣāliḥātu qānitātun ḥāfiẓātun lil-ghaybi bimā ḥafiẓa llāh
dialogue.en: «So the righteous women are obedient and guard in the husband's absence what Allah has guarded.» (Quran)
dialogue.ur: «Pas nek aurtein farmanbardar hain aur ghaib mein us cheez ki hifazat karti hain jiski Allah ne hifazat ki.» (Quran)

dialogue.ar: «تُنْكَحُ المَرْأَةُ لِأَرْبَعٍ: لِمالِها وَلِحَسَبِها وَلِجَمالِها وَلِدينِها، فَاظْفَرْ بِذاتِ الدّينِ، تَرِبَتْ يَداكَ».
dialogue.tr: tunkaḥu l-mar'atu li-arbaʿ: li-mālihā wa li-ḥasabihā wa li-jamālihā wa li-dīnihā, faẓfar bi-dhāti d-dīn, taribat yadāk
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ said: a woman is married for four things: her wealth, her family standing, her beauty and her religion; so win the one with religion.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya: aurat se chaar wajoohat ki bina par nikaah kiya jata hai: uske maal, khandaan, husn aur deen ki wajah se; tum deendar ko hasil karo.

dialogue.ar: وَذاتُ الدّينِ يَطْمَئِنُّ إِلَيْهَا القَلْبُ، وَيَأْمَنُها المَرْءُ عَلى نَفْسِهِ وَمالِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa dhātu d-dīni yaṭma'innu ilayhā l-qalb, wa ya'manuhā l-mar'u ʿalā nafsihi wa mālih
dialogue.en: The religious woman brings peace to the heart, and a man trusts her with himself and his wealth.
dialogue.ur: Deendar aurat se dil ko itminan hota hai aur mard apni jaan aur maal ke baare mein us par bharosa karta hai.

dialogue.ar: وَعَلى الوَلِيِّ أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ وَلِيَّتَهُ، وَيَسْتَأْمِرَها.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿalā l-waliyyi an yasta'dhina waliyyatahu wa yasta'mirahā
dialogue.en: The guardian should ask permission of the girl under his care and consult her.
dialogue.ur: Sarparast par lazim hai ke apni zer-e-kafalat ladki se ijazat le aur us se mashwara kare.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَهَمِّ صِفاتِ مَنْ يَخْتارُها الرَّجُلُ أَنْ تَكونَ ذاتَ خُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa min ahammi ṣifāti man yakhtāruhā r-rajulu an takūna dhāta khuluqin ḥasan
dialogue.en: Among the most important qualities of the one a man chooses is good character.
dialogue.ur: Jise mard chunta hai uski aham sifaat mein se achha akhlaaq hai.

dialogue.ar: أَباحَ الإِسْلامُ لِلْخاطِبِ وَالمَخْطوبَةِ أَنْ يَرى أَحَدُهُما الآخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: abāḥa l-islāmu lil-khāṭibi wal-makhṭūbati an yarā aḥaduhumā l-ākhar
dialogue.en: Islam permitted the suitor and the one proposed to, to see one another.
dialogue.ur: Islam ne rishta bhejne wale aur manguni wali ke liye jaiz rakha ke ek doosre ko dekh len.

q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq nikaah kyun zaroori hai?

q.en: What is the most important quality of a wife in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein biwi ki sab se aham sifat kya hai?
q.ar: ما أَهَمُّ صِفَةٍ في الزَّوْجَةِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What does «الزَّوْجَة» mean?
What does «الخاطِب» mean?

title.en: Grammar A: The Work of the Masdar

intro.en: A verbal noun (masdar) can work like a verb: it can take an object. Example: صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ (your doing good is an honour for you) = أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ. The object (المَعْروفَ) stays in the accusative. A masdar can also be replaced by «أَنْ + verb» or «ما + verb».
intro.ur: Masdar kabhi fe'l ki tarah kaam karta hai aur maf'ool ko nasb deta hai. Misaal: صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ (tera neki karna tere liye izzat hai) = أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ. Masdar ki jagah «أَنْ + fe'l» ya «ما + fe'l» bhi aa sakta hai.
intro.ar: يَعْمَلُ المَصْدَرُ عَمَلَ فِعْلِهِ فَيَنْصِبُ مَفْعولاً بِهِ. مِثالٌ: «صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ» أَيْ أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ، وَيَبْقى المَفْعولُ (المَعْروفَ) مَنْصوباً. وَيُمْكِنُ تَأْويلُ المَصْدَرِ بِـ«أَنْ» وَالفِعْلِ أَوْ بِـ«ما» وَالفِعْلِ.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ تَصْنَعَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ.
dialogue.tr: an taṣnaʿa l-maʿrūfa sharafun lak
dialogue.en: That you do good is an honour for you.
dialogue.ur: Tera neki karna tere liye izzat hai.

dialogue.ar: صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ شَرَفٌ لَكَ.
dialogue.tr: ṣunʿuka l-maʿrūfa sharafun lak
dialogue.en: Your doing good is an honour for you.
dialogue.ur: Tera neki karna tere liye izzat hai.

dialogue.ar: أَنْ تَصْحَبَ الجُهّالَ مَسَبَّةٌ لَكَ.
dialogue.tr: an taṣḥaba l-juhhāla masabbatun lak
dialogue.en: That you keep company with the ignorant is a disgrace for you.
dialogue.ur: Jahilon ki sohbat tere liye ruswai hai.

dialogue.ar: يَسُرُّني أَنْ تُساعِدَ أَخاكَ.
dialogue.tr: yasurrunī an tusāʿida akhāk
dialogue.en: It pleases me that you help your brother.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe khushi hoti hai ke tum apne bhai ki madad karo.

dialogue.ar: يَسُرُّني مُساعَدَتُكَ أَخاكَ.
dialogue.tr: yasurrunī musāʿadatuka akhāk
dialogue.en: Your helping your brother pleases me.
dialogue.ur: Tumhara apne bhai ki madad karna mujhe khush karta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَحْبَبْتُكَ لِعَطائِكَ الفُقَراءَ.
dialogue.tr: aḥbabtuka li-ʿaṭā'ika l-fuqarā'
dialogue.en: I loved you for your giving to the poor.
dialogue.ur: Maine tujhse mohabbat ki kyunke tu faqeeron ko deta hai.

dialogue.ar: قَدِّروا جُهودَ العُلَماءِ.
dialogue.tr: qaddirū juhūda l-ʿulamā'
dialogue.en: Appreciate the efforts of the scholars.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ki koshishon ki qadar karo.

dialogue.ar: تَقْديراً جُهودَ العُلَماءِ.
dialogue.tr: taqdīran juhūda l-ʿulamā'
dialogue.en: Appreciating the efforts of the scholars.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ki koshishon ki qadardani karte hue.

dialogue.ar: أَطْعِموا الفُقَراءَ.
dialogue.tr: aṭʿimū l-fuqarā'
dialogue.en: Feed the poor.
dialogue.ur: Faqeeron ko khana khilao.

dialogue.ar: إِطْعاماً الفُقَراءَ.
dialogue.tr: iṭʿāman l-fuqarā'
dialogue.en: Feeding the poor.
dialogue.ur: Faqeeron ko khana khilana.

dialogue.ar: مُشاوَرَتُكَ العُلَماءَ دَليلُ عَقْلٍ.
dialogue.tr: mushāwaratuka l-ʿulamā'a dalīlu ʿaql
dialogue.en: Your consulting the scholars is a sign of intelligence.
dialogue.ur: Tera ulama se mashwara karna aqal ki daleel hai.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ حُسْنِ الأَدَبِ أَنْ تَحْتَرِمَ الكَبيرَ.
dialogue.tr: min ḥusni l-adabi an taḥtarima l-kabīr
dialogue.en: Part of good manners is that you respect the elder.
dialogue.ur: Achhe adab mein se hai ke tum bade ka ehtiram karo.

q.en: Which phrase can replace «أَنْ تُساعِدَ أَخاكَ» using a masdar?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla «أَنْ تُساعِدَ أَخاكَ» ki jagah masdar ke saath aa sakta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَحُلُّ مَحَلَّ «أَنْ تُساعِدَ أَخاكَ» بِاسْتِعْمالِ المَصْدَرِ؟

q.en: What does «شَرَف» mean?
What does «الفُقَراء» mean?

options_ar: المُحْتاجونَ الَّذينَ لا يَمْلِكونَ ما يَكْفيهِمْ

q.en: In «صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ», what does the masdar «صُنْعُكَ» do?
q.ur: «صُنْعُكَ المَعْروفَ» mein masdar «صُنْعُكَ» kya karta hai?

options: Works like a verb and takes an object

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna (1): Ajeeb shaadi ki raat

intro.en: Listen to the story of the judge Shurayh and his wife, then answer the true/false and multiple-choice questions. The slides here give the questions; the story is in the audio.
intro.ur: Qazi Shurayh aur unki biwi ki kahani suniye, phir sahi/ghalat aur sawalaat ke jawab dein. Slides mein sirf sawal hain, kahani audio mein hai.
intro.ar: اسْتَمِعْ إِلى قِصَّةِ القاضي شُرَيْحٍ وَزَوْجَتِهِ، ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ وَالِاخْتِيارِ مِنْ مُتَعَدِّدٍ. تَعْرِضُ الشَّرائِحُ الأَسْئِلَةَ، وَالقِصَّةُ في التَّسْجيلِ الصَّوْتِيِّ.

dialogue.ar: كانَ شُرَيْحٌ قاضِياً مَشْهوراً.
dialogue.tr: kāna Shurayḥun qāḍiyan mashhūrā
dialogue.en: Shurayh was a famous judge.
dialogue.ur: Shurayh ek mashhoor qazi the.

dialogue.ar: لَمْ تُخْطِئْ زَوْجَةُ شُرَيْحٍ في حَقِّ زَوْجِها عِشْرينَ عاماً.
dialogue.tr: lam tukhṭi' zawjatu Shurayḥin fī ḥaqqi zawjihā ʿishrīna ʿāmā
dialogue.en: Shurayh's wife did not wrong her husband for twenty years.
dialogue.ur: Shurayh ki biwi ne bees saal tak shauhar ke haq mein koi ghalti nahi ki.

dialogue.ar: حينَما خَطَبَتْ زَوْجَةُ شُرَيْحٍ لَيْلَةَ زِفافِها... شُرَيْحٌ صَلّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ شُكْراً لله.
dialogue.tr: ḥīnamā khaṭabat zawjatu Shurayḥin laylata zifāfihā
dialogue.en: When Shurayh's wife spoke on her wedding night, Shurayh prayed two rak'ahs in thanks to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi ki raat jab Shurayh ki biwi ne baat ki to Shurayh ne shukrane ke do rakat padhi.

q.en: Who was Shurayh?
How long did Shurayh stay with his wife (in the questions)?
q.ur: Sawalaat ke mutabiq Shurayh apni biwi ke saath kitni muddat rahe?
q.ar: كَمْ مَكَثَ شُرَيْحٌ مَعَ زَوْجَتِهِ (في الأَسْئِلَةِ)؟

q.en: What does «عُرْس» mean?
What did Shurayh do in thanks to Allah?
q.ur: Shurayh ne Allah ka shukr ada karne ke liye kya kiya?

intro.en: The story of Ibn Abi Wada'a and the great scholar Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab, who married his daughter to him for a small dowry. Then a speaking exercise: discuss modern topics with a classmate.
intro.ur: Ibn Abi Wada'a aur bade aalim Saeed bin al-Musayyab ki kahani, jinhon ne thode mahar par apni beti ka nikaah unse kiya. Phir guftagu ki mashq: saathi se jadeed mauzuaat par baat karein.
intro.ar: قِصَّةُ ابْنِ أَبي وَداعَةَ وَالعالِمِ الكَبيرِ سَعيدِ بْنِ المُسَيَّبِ الَّذي زَوَّجَهُ ابْنَتَهُ بِمَهْرٍ يَسيرٍ. ثُمَّ تَمْرينٌ عَلى الكَلامِ: تُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلِكَ مَوْضوعاتٍ مُعاصِرَةً.

dialogue.ar: كانَ ابْنُ أَبي وَداعَةَ يُلازِمُ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: kāna bnu Abī Wadāʿata yulāzimu l-masjida n-nabawiyy
dialogue.en: Ibn Abi Wada'a used to stay constantly in the Prophet's Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Ibn Abi Wada'a Masjid-e-Nabawi mein lagataar rehte the.

dialogue.ar: كانَ ابْنُ أَبي وَداعَةَ مِنْ تَلاميذِ سَعيدِ بْنِ المُسَيِّبِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna bnu Abī Wadāʿata min talāmīdhi Saʿīdi bni l-Musayyab
dialogue.en: Ibn Abi Wada'a was one of the students of Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab.
dialogue.ur: Ibn Abi Wada'a Saeed bin al-Musayyab ke shagirdon mein se the.

dialogue.ar: تَغَيَّبَ ابْنُ أَبي وَداعَةَ عَنْ حَلْقاتِ الدَّرْسِ لِوَفاةِ زَوْجَتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: taghayyaba bnu Abī Wadāʿata ʿan ḥalaqāti d-darsi li-wafāti zawjatih
dialogue.en: Ibn Abi Wada'a was absent from the study circles because of his wife's death.
dialogue.ur: Ibn Abi Wada'a biwi ke inteqal ki wajah se dars ki mehfilon se gair haazir rahe.

dialogue.ar: زَوَّجَ ابْنُ المُسَيِّبِ ابْنَتَهُ لِابْنِ أَبي وَداعَةَ لِأَنَّهُ ذو خُلُقٍ وَدينٍ.
dialogue.tr: zawwaja bnu l-Musayyabi bnatahu li-bni Abī Wadāʿata li-annahu dhū khuluqin wa dīn
dialogue.en: Ibn al-Musayyab married his daughter to Ibn Abi Wada'a because he had character and religion.
dialogue.ur: Ibn al-Musayyab ne apni beti ka nikaah Ibn Abi Wada'a se kiya kyunke woh achhe akhlaaq aur deen wale the.

dialogue.ar: كانَ مَهْرُ بِنْتِ ابْنِ المُسَيِّبِ دِرْهَمَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna mahru bnti bni l-Musayyabi dirhamayn
dialogue.en: The dowry of Ibn al-Musayyab's daughter was two dirhams.
dialogue.ur: Ibn al-Musayyab ki beti ka mahar do dirham tha.

dialogue.ar: خَطَبَ ابْنَةَ سَعيدِ بْنِ المُسَيِّبِ الوَليدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ المَلِكِ.
dialogue.tr: khaṭaba bnata Saʿīdi bni l-Musayyabi l-Walīdu bnu ʿAbdi l-Malik
dialogue.en: Al-Walid ibn Abd al-Malik had proposed to Sa'id ibn al-Musayyab's daughter.
dialogue.ur: Walid bin Abdul Malik ne Saeed bin al-Musayyab ki beti ka rishta bheja tha.

dialogue.ar: تَمَّ العَقْدُ عَلى ابْنَةِ ابْنِ المُسَيِّبِ في المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: tamma l-ʿaqdu ʿalā bnati bni l-Musayyabi fī l-masjid
dialogue.en: The marriage contract was completed in the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Nikaah ka aqd masjid mein mukammal hua.

dialogue.ar: حاوِرْ زَميلَكَ في المَوْضوعاتِ التّالِيَةِ: الكِتابُ الوَرَقيُّ أَوِ الإِلِكْتِرونيُّ، العَوْلَمَةُ نِعْمَةٌ أَوْ نِقْمَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ḥāwir zamīlaka fī l-mawḍūʿāti t-tāliya
dialogue.en: Discuss with your classmate: the paper or the electronic book; is globalisation a blessing or a curse.
dialogue.ur: Apne saathi se in mauzuaat par baat karein: kaghazi ya electronic kitaab, aalamgiriyat nemat ya azaab.

q.en: Whose student was Ibn Abi Wada'a?
q.ur: Ibn Abi Wada'a kiske shagird the?
q.ar: تِلْميذُ مَنْ كانَ ابْنُ أَبي وَداعَةَ؟

q.en: Why did Ibn al-Musayyab marry his daughter to him?
q.ur: Ibn al-Musayyab ne apni beti ka nikaah unse kyun kiya?

options: Because he had character and religion

q.en: How much was the dowry in the story?
Where was the marriage contract done?
What does «مَهْر» mean?

options_ar: المالُ الَّذي يَدْفَعُهُ الزَّوْجُ لِزَوْجَتِهِ عِنْدَ الزَّواجِ

intro.en: We can make a verb stronger by adding the emphatic noon (نونُ التَّوْكيد), light (نْ) or heavy (نَّ). Examples: اِقْرَأَنَّ (surely read!), لَنَخْرُجَنَّ (we will surely go out). The emphasis is obligatory, allowed or forbidden depending on the verb's form; for example after an oath it is obligatory for a future verb.
intro.ur: Fe'l ko mazboot karne ke liye nun-e-takeed lagate hain: halka (نْ) ya bhaari (نَّ). Misaal: اِقْرَأَنَّ (zaroor parho!), لَنَخْرُجَنَّ (hum zaroor niklenge). Fe'l ki shakl ke mutabiq takeed wajib, jaiz ya mumtani hoti hai; jaise qasam ke jawab mein mustaqbil ke fe'l par wajib.
intro.ar: نَسْتَطيعُ تَقْوِيَةَ الفِعْلِ بِإِضافَةِ نونِ التَّوْكيدِ خَفيفَةً (نْ) أَوْ ثَقيلَةً (نَّ). أَمْثِلَةٌ: اِقْرَأَنَّ، لَنَخْرُجَنَّ. وَيَكونُ التَّوْكيدُ واجِباً أَوْ جائِزاً أَوْ مُمْتَنِعاً بِحَسَبِ صورَةِ الفِعْلِ؛ فَهُوَ واجِبٌ مَثَلاً في الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ المُسْتَقْبَلِ إِذا جاءَ بَعْدَ القَسَمِ.

dialogue.ar: ﴿اقْرَأْ بِاسْمِ رَبِّكَ الَّذي خَلَقَ﴾ ← اِقْرَأَنَّ
dialogue.tr: iqraʾ bismi rabbika → iqra'anna
dialogue.en: Read in the name of your Lord → surely read.
dialogue.ur: Apne Rab ke naam se parho → zaroor parho.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَتَاللهِ لَأَكيدَنَّ أَصْنامَكُمْ﴾
dialogue.tr: wa-tallāhi la-akīdanna aṣnāmakum
dialogue.en: By Allah, I will surely plot against your idols.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, main tumhare butoon ke saath zaroor chaal chalunga.

dialogue.ar: ﴿لَئِنْ أُخْرِجْتُمْ لَنَخْرُجَنَّ مَعَكُمْ﴾
dialogue.tr: la-in ukhrijtum la-nakhrujanna maʿakum
dialogue.en: If you are driven out, we will surely go out with you.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum nikale gaye to hum zaroor tumhare saath niklenge.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَلا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللهَ غافِلاً﴾
dialogue.tr: wa lā taḥsabanna llāha ghāfilā
dialogue.en: And never think that Allah is unaware.
dialogue.ur: Aur hargiz Allah ko ghaafil na samajhna.

dialogue.ar: ﴿وَلَنَبْلُوَنَّكُمْ حَتّى نَعْلَمَ المُجاهِدينَ مِنْكُمْ وَالصّابِرينَ﴾
dialogue.tr: wa-la-nabluwannakum ḥattā naʿlama l-mujāhidīna minkum waṣ-ṣābirīn
dialogue.en: We will surely test you until We know those who strive and are patient among you.
dialogue.ur: Hum zaroor tumhe aazmayenge yahan tak ke hum jaan len tum mein se mujahid aur sabr karne wale kaun hain.

vocab.ur: woh yaad karta / hifazat karta hai

q.en: What does «واجِب» mean?
Which of these is an emphasised verb?

intro.en: Scene two: Abu Bakr, in his last illness, consults the Companions about appointing Umar ibn al-Khattab as the next caliph, dictates the covenant, and then the people agree. A play by Ali Ahmad Bakathir, lightly adapted. Read it with the speakers in mind.
intro.ur: Doosra manzar: Hazrat Abu Bakr, aakhri beemari mein, Sahaba se Umar bin al-Khattab ko khalifa banane par mashwara karte hain, ahd likhwate hain aur phir logon se bait lete hain. Ali Ahmad Bakathir ka drama, mukhtasar kiya gaya.
intro.ar: المَشْهَدُ الثّاني: يَسْتَشيرُ أَبو بَكْرٍ في مَرَضِهِ الأَخيرِ الصَّحابَةَ في اسْتِخْلافِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخَطّابِ، وَيُمْلي العَهْدَ، ثُمَّ يُوافِقُ النّاسُ. مَسْرَحِيَّةٌ لِعَلي أَحْمَد باكَثير بِتَصَرُّفٍ يَسيرٍ. اقْرَأْها مُراعِياً المُتَكَلِّمينَ.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ بَعَثْتَ إِلَيْنا يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ؟
dialogue.tr: hal baʿatta ilaynā yā khalīfata rasūli llāh?
dialogue.en: Did you send for us, O successor of the Messenger of Allah?
dialogue.ur: Aye khalifa-e-Rasoolullah, kya aap ne hamein bulaya?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، كَما بَعَثْتُ إِلى غَيْرِكُمْ مِنَ المُهاجِرينَ وَالأَنْصارِ؛ لِأَسْتَرْشِدَ بِآرائِكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, kamā baʿathtu ilā ghayrikum mina l-muhājirīna wal-anṣār; li-astarshida bi-ārā'ikum
dialogue.en: Yes, as I sent for others among the Muhajirun and Ansar, to seek guidance from your opinions.
dialogue.ur: Haan, jaise maine doosre Muhajireen aur Ansaar ko bulaya, taake aap ki raaye se rahnumai loon.

dialogue.ar: إِنّي أُريدُ أَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفَ عَلَيْكُمْ رَجُلاً قَوِيّاً أَميناً.
dialogue.tr: innī urīdu an astakhlifa ʿalaykum rajulan qawiyyan amīnā
dialogue.en: I want to appoint over you a successor who is a strong, trustworthy man.
dialogue.ur: Main chahta hoon ke aap par ek taaqatwar aur amanat-daar shakhs ko khalifa banaun.

dialogue.ar: فَماذا تَرَوْنَ؟ ماذا تَرى يا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمنِ في عُمَرَ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-mādhā tarawn? mādhā tarā yā ʿAbda r-raḥmāni fī ʿUmar?
dialogue.en: What do you think? What do you think, Abd ar-Rahman, of Umar?
dialogue.ur: Aap kya samajhte hain? Aye Abdurrahman, Umar ke baare mein aap ki kya raaye hai?

dialogue.ar: ما تَسْأَلُني عَنْ أَمْرٍ، إِلّا وَأَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنّي.
dialogue.tr: mā tas'alunī ʿan amrin illā wa anta aʿlamu bihi minnī
dialogue.en: You do not ask me about a matter except that you know more about it than I.
dialogue.ur: Aap mujh se jis baat ke baare mein poochte hain, aap mujh se behtar jaante hain.

dialogue.ar: هُوَ وَاللهِ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ رَأْيِكَ فيهِ.
dialogue.tr: huwa wallāhi afḍalu min raʾyika fīh
dialogue.en: By Allah, he is better than your opinion of him.
dialogue.ur: Allah ki qasam, woh aap ki raaye se bhi behtar hain.

dialogue.ar: اللَّهُمَّ عِلْمي أَنَّ سَريرَتَهُ خَيْرٌ مِنْ عَلانِيَتِهِ، وَأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ فينا مِثْلُهُ.
dialogue.tr: allāhumma ʿilmī anna sarīratahu khayrun min ʿalāniyatih, wa annahu laysa fīnā mithluh
dialogue.en: O Allah, I know that his inner self is better than his outward, and that there is none like him among us.
dialogue.ur: Aye Allah, mera ilm hai ke uska baatin uske zahir se behtar hai aur hum mein uske jaisa koi nahi.

dialogue.ar: لا يا عُثْمانُ لا تَفْعَلْ، وَلَكِنْ هاتِ قِرْطاسَكَ وَقَلَمَكَ لِأُمْلِيَ عَلَيْكَ كِتابَ العَهْدِ.
dialogue.tr: lā yā ʿUthmānu lā tafʿal, wa lākin hāti qirṭāsaka wa qalamaka li-umliya ʿalayka kitāba l-ʿahd
dialogue.en: No, Uthman, do not; rather bring your paper and pen so that I dictate the covenant to you.
dialogue.ur: Nahi Usman, aisa mat karo, balke apna kaghaz aur qalam lao taake main tumhe ahd-nama likhwaun.

dialogue.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحيمِ. هَذا ما عَهِدَ أَبو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبي قُحافَةَ في آخِرِ عَهْدِهِ بِالدُّنْيا.
dialogue.tr: bismi llāhi r-raḥmāni r-raḥīm. hādhā mā ʿahida Abū Bakri bnu Abī Quḥāfata fī ākhiri ʿahdihi bi-d-dunyā
dialogue.en: In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful. This is what Abu Bakr ibn Abi Quhafa pledged at the end of his time in this world.
dialogue.ur: Allah ke naam se jo bada meherbaan nihayat rahem hai. Yeh woh ahd hai jo Abu Bakr bin Abi Quhafa ne dunya mein apne aakhri waqt mein kiya.

dialogue.ar: إِنّي اسْتَخْلَفْتُ عَلَيْكُمْ عُمَرَ بْنَ الخَطّابِ.
dialogue.tr: innī istakhlaftu ʿalaykum ʿUmara bna l-khaṭṭāb
dialogue.en: I have appointed Umar ibn al-Khattab as successor over you.
dialogue.ur: Maine Umar bin al-Khattab ko aap par apna jaanasheen banaya hai.

dialogue.ar: خَشيتُ إِنِ افْتُلِتَتْ نَفْسي في غَشْيَتي تِلْكَ أَنْ يَخْتَلِفَ النّاسُ؟
dialogue.tr: khashītu ini ftulitat nafsī fī ghashyatī tilka an yakhtalifa n-nās
dialogue.en: I feared that if my soul were taken in that faint, the people would disagree.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe dar tha ke agar us behoshi mein meri jaan nikal gayi to log ikhtilaf karenge.

dialogue.ar: جَزاكَ اللهُ خَيْراً عَنِ الإِسْلامِ وَأَهْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: jazāka llāhu khayran ʿani l-islāmi wa ahlih
dialogue.en: May Allah reward you well on behalf of Islam and its people.
dialogue.ur: Allah aap ko Islam aur ahl-e-Islam ki taraf se behtareen badla de.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ عائِشَةُ أُمُّ المُؤْمِنينَ يا أَبا بَكْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi ʿĀ'ishatu ummu l-mu'minīna yā Abā Bakr
dialogue.en: This is Aisha, Mother of the Believers, O Abu Bakr.
dialogue.ur: Yeh Ummul Momineen Aisha hain, aye Abu Bakr.

dialogue.ar: مَرْحَباً بِعائِشَةَ، مَرْحَباً بِأُمِّ المُؤْمِنينَ.
dialogue.tr: marḥaban bi-ʿĀ'isha, marḥaban bi-ummi l-mu'minīn
dialogue.en: Welcome, Aisha; welcome, Mother of the Believers.
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed Aisha, khush aamdeed Ummul Momineen.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّها النّاسُ، يا مَعْشَرَ المُسْلِمينَ، أَصْغوا إِلَيَّ، فَلَعَلَّكُمْ لا تَسْمَعونَ صَوْتي بَعْدَ اليَوْمِ.
dialogue.tr: ayyuhā n-nās, yā maʿshara l-muslimīn, aṣghū ilayy, fa-laʿallakum lā tasmaʿūna ṣawtī baʿda l-yawm
dialogue.en: O people, O community of Muslims, listen to me, perhaps you will not hear my voice after today.
dialogue.ur: Aye logo, aye musalmano, meri baat suno, shayad aaj ke baad meri awaaz na sun sako.

dialogue.ar: أَتَرْضَوْنَ بِمَنْ أَسْتَخْلِفُهُ عَلَيْكُمْ؟
dialogue.tr: a-tarḍawna bi-man astakhlifuhu ʿalaykum?
dialogue.en: Are you pleased with the one I appoint over you?
dialogue.ur: Kya aap us par razi hain jise main aap par khalifa banata hoon?

dialogue.ar: رَضينا يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ، مَنْ تَسْتَخْلِفْ عَلَيْنا نَرْضَ بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: raḍīnā yā khalīfata rasūli llāh, man tastakhlif ʿalaynā narḍa bih
dialogue.en: We are pleased, O successor of the Messenger of Allah; whomever you appoint over us, we accept.
dialogue.ur: Hum razi hain aye khalifa-e-Rasoolullah, jise aap hum par khalifa banayen hum usse razi hain.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْنا وَأَطَعْنا يا خَليفَةَ رَسولِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: samiʿnā wa aṭaʿnā yā khalīfata rasūli llāh
dialogue.en: We hear and we obey, O successor of the Messenger of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Hum ne suna aur maana, aye khalifa-e-Rasoolullah.

q.ur: Abu Bakr ne apna jaanasheen kise chuna?

What did the people answer in the end?
